speaker: Doctor

text: It’s a dark, irregularly shaped spot with uneven borders that looks a bit raised compared to the surrounding skin. It hasn't bled or crusted over, but the color seems to be changing slightly. I want to emphasize that, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.
